title: FiniteCoconeLimitBoundaries
statement: For a type-zero bigraded exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple], diagonal alpha cocones A [def-sp-convergence] with invertible structure maps at all sufficiently small first indices on each total-degree diagonal, and any limiting subobjects L, the limiting boundaries L.B(p,q) are the direct image under initialG(p,q) of the kernel of the transported structure map D(p,q) -> A(p+q).obj. No regularity or upper zero tail is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the finite boundary formula finiteBoundary_alphaKernel at each natural index. Induct on r using the consecutive cocone equation to identify the transported structure map j_p with alphaIter r followed by the transported cocone map at p-r. Its kernel therefore contains the alphaIter kernel, so every boundary is below initialG(ker j_p).

Choose a left-tail bound a for total degree p+q, and r=(p-a).toNat. Then p-r<=a. The transported tail map is invertible, so postcomposition does not change the alphaIter kernel. The r-th boundary therefore equals initialG(ker j_p). Use L.B_lub to bound L.B above by that value and below by the r-th boundary; antisymmetry concludes.

proof_origin.place: Tags 011T and 012W; K1 formalized the cocone iteration, kernel containment/cancellation, natural-number tail bound and LUB argument. The finite-boundary induction is isolated as lem-sp-finite-boundary-alpha-kernel.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCocone_limitBoundaries
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (A : ∀ n : ℤ, X.AlphaColimit n)
    (hleft : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ P : ℤ, P ≤ a → IsIso ((A n).ι P))
    (L : X.LimitSubobjects) (p q : ℤ) :
    L.B p q = (Subobject.«exists» (X.initialG p q)).obj
      (kernelSubobject (eqToHom (by congr 1; omega) ≫ (A (p + q)).ι p))
